summary: Bounded byte-string comparison against a fixed 8-byte reference buffer at byte_5AF564. It clamps the comparison length to the 8-byte window starting at index a2, returns 0 immediately when the requested length is zero or the window start exceeds 7, and otherwise returns the memcmp result for that window.

operations.description: If requested length a3 is zero, return 0 immediately (empty comparison succeeds).
Clamp comparison length v3 to at most 8 by capping a3 at 8.
If window start a2 exceeds 7, return 0 immediately (outside the 8-byte reference window).
If a2 + v3 would exceed 8, shrink v3 to 8 - a2 so the compared range stays inside the 8-byte reference buffer.
memcmp over v3 bytes comparing the caller buffer at a1 + a2 against the reference buffer byte_5AF564 starting at index a2.
Return the memcmp result (0 when equal, otherwise sign reflects the first differing byte).

unresolved: The content and semantic meaning of the 8-byte reference buffer at byte_5AF564 are unknown.
What a1 points to (the buffer being matched) is unknown; known callers are sub_50210E and sub_5119E9.
